info.title: Recruitment & ATS API
info.description:
Backend for a multi-role Recruitment & Applicant Tracking System (Express 5 + Prisma + PostgreSQL).

**Auth**: login sets an httpOnly cookie `token` (8h JWT); the same JWT is returned in the response body and can be sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

**Roles**: EMPLOYER, RECRUITER, HIRING_MANAGER (staff, scoped to one organization; hiring managers only see jobs where they are hiringManager) and CANDIDATE.

Demo (seeded) account: `recruiter@acme.test` / `Password123!` (also employer@, manager@, candidate@acme.test).

post.description:
Returns **200** `{moved:true}` when moved, or **202** `{moved:false, approvalId}` when the target stage requires approval and the caller is not an authorised approver (a PENDING StageApproval is created or reused). EMPLOYER can always approve; otherwise caller role must equal the stage approverRole (HIRING_MANAGER must own the job). Optimistic lock: concurrent move -> 409. 400 if stage is from another job or is already the current stage; 409 if application is not ACTIVE.

**Roles allowed:** EMPLOYER, RECRUITER, HIRING_MANAGER.

202.description: Approval required; application NOT moved yet

example.error: Application was changed by someone else, refresh and retry

moved.summary: Target stage has no approval gate (200)

approval.summary: Target is the Offer stage and caller is a RECRUITER (202)

post.description:
Moves to the job's REJECTED stage and stores the reason. Returns the same shape as move (200 moved / 202 if the rejected stage requires approval).

**Roles allowed:** EMPLOYER, RECRUITER, HIRING_MANAGER.

patch.summary: Reschedule, edit or change status of an interview

**Roles allowed:** EMPLOYER, RECRUITER, HIRING_MANAGER.

post.description:

**Roles allowed:** EMPLOYER, RECRUITER, HIRING_MANAGER.
